name: Bobble Ball
author: Addicting Games
description: Bobble Ball is a free sports game. Volley Ball is now and has always been a game of kings, queens, Jacks, princes, some jokers, and even knights. Now you can become basically as cool and talented as a world-class soccer player and feel as powerful as a monarch in this free and exciting Volley Ball game: Bobble Ball perfectly re-creates the fast-paced world of volleyball with an amazingly accurate physics engine and am AI that knows your every move before you do. Games are scored out of three and the first player to make it all the way to three is the winner. You can choose from easy, medium, and hard skill levels as you tackle the world of volleyball. Simply move forward or backward and become one with the physics engine in order to understand how it all works and achieve your wildest dreams.
